messages:
Anna L: Quick heads-up — product wants to deprecate the old tool output shape (v1/tool-output) next Tuesday. We need a rollout plan for validation, routing fallbacks, and console visibility.
Mohit K: Ok. Do we have migration telemetry? e.g., how many callers still send v1 & failure rates?
Jess P: We have ~2.3k hits/day that still return v1 in logs; ~0.8% of requests fail strict validation currently. Can surface `schema_reject_rate` in console.
Anna L: My concerns: abrupt strict rejects will cause errors for customers using SDK older than v2. We should do a gradual policy: soft-validate -> flag -> strict. Also need quota accounting when we fallback to legacy runtime.
Mohit K: Agreed. Proposal: 1) Soft-validate for 72h with telemetry and sample payload capture; 2) Canary strict validate for 5% of traffic for 48h; 3) Ramp to 100% strict with 7-day rollback window.
Jess P: For soft-validate, what should the behavior be? Log + add `validation_warning` header, but still return the normalized v2 output? Or preserve original output?
Anna L: Prefer to return normalized (v2) so downstream sees consistent shape, but include `x-redwood-validate-warning: v1-detected` and keep the original payload in the sample store for debugging.
Mohit K: Need to adjust routing policy too. If strict validate fails and fallback is allowed, route to legacy-runner and mark as `fallback=legacy`. That should consume quota from the same customer bucket and surface in console metrics.
SRE Oncall: Important: legacy-runner has different latency profile. We should tag traces with `runtime=legacy` vs `runtime=optimized` so perf dashboards don't mix. Add an alert if p95 latency for legacy > 2x baseline.
Jess P: Console changes: add a per-route tile showing `schema_reject_rate`, `fallback_rate`, `fallback_runtime`, and example rejected payloads (sampled). Also add ability to filter samples by `customer_id` and `time`. But need to ensure PII is redacted in samples.
Anna L: Right — sample store must apply PII redaction pipeline. We already have that component; ensure it's in the canary path. Add a toggle to enable/disable sample retention per org for compliance.
Mohit K: Telemetry detail: event names: `validation.soft_detect`, `validation.strict_reject`, `validation.fallback_invoked`. Each event should include `route`, `model`, `runtime`, `customer_tier`, `validator_version`. Also emit `sample_id` when we keep a sample.
Jess P: For rollout UX: in the route rollout modal, show a breakdown: percent traffic canary -> expected rejects -> estimated number of fallbacks (based on historical reject_rate). Compute estimated cost delta if routed to legacy (using per-token cost multiplier).
Anna L: Good — product wants cost estimate upfront. Also add a checkbox: auto-fallback to legacy when strict validation fails (on/off). Default: on for dev & svc tiers, off for enterprise.
Mohit K: Implementation plan for API: new flag in route config: `validation_policy: { mode: "soft|strict", fallback: "legacy|normalize|reject" , validator_version: "v2.1" }`. We'll need server-side enforcement + client SDK exposure.
Jess P: Backwards compatibility: if route config absent, default to `soft` and `fallback=normalize`. We should also add a deprecation header on responses for v1 callers `x-redwood-deprecation: tool-output-v1` with link to migration doc.
SRE Oncall: Ops playbook: if strict rollout causes >1% error spike or increased 5xxs, auto-pause rollout and open incident. infra-bot: can we automate that?
infra-bot: +1 — we can hook the rollout job to metric alerts: `validation.strict_reject_rate > threshold OR route_5xx_rate increase > 30%` -> pause and ping #incidents + owners.
Anna L: Action items: Mohit to prototype server flags + telemetry (ETA 3d). Jess to mock console tile + rollout modal copy (ETA 2d). SRE Oncall to draft alert thresholds and incident steps (ETA 1d). I will write migration doc and update SDK notes.
Mohit K: One more: we should add a debug CLI to fetch a sample by `sample_id` with ACL check, something like `rwctl samples get --id <sample_id> --redact` for engineering.
Jess P: I'll add sample viewer with redaction preview and an audit log entry for each view.
Anna L: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10:30 to unblock approvals. :thumbsup:
